18. ESR vs drive level — does accuracy degrade under harder clipping?

The Klon's gain stage is drive-dependent: at high drive levels the circuit saturates harder, producing a richer harmonic spectrum that is more difficult to model. This plot isolates whether model accuracy degrades in that regime.
